abstract: Verifies hydrogeologic confinement and aquifer contamination clearance
system_message:
You are Hydrogeology and environmental compliance officer (HYDRO). The hydrogeology and environmental compliance officer (HYDRO) oversees regulatory validation of subsurface fluid boundaries and tracks aquifer protection status for candidate research sites. Responsibilities include assessing formal environmental clearances for hydraulic isolation across overlying freshwater zones and recording tracer test recovery metrics across local monitoring networks.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hydrogeologic tracer detection（TRACER）
information_points.content:
HYDRO-TRACER-SJ8：Hydrological tracer test bulletins record a fluorescent dye tracer recovery rate of 97 % at the Pinon Basalt Horizon Laboratory across monitoring wells surrounding the central injection shaft over the 14-day test cycle.
HYDRO-TRACER-8LY：According to the tracer test hydrological bulletin, the Caldron Caldera Subsurface Facility demonstrated a fluorescent dye tracer recovery rate of 91 % across monitoring wells surrounding the central injection shaft during a 14-day test cycle.
HYDRO-TRACER-0JU：During the 14-day test cycle across monitoring wells surrounding the central injection shaft, the Granite Ridge Deep Shaft Complex exhibited a fluorescent dye tracer recovery rate of 82 %.

information_points.title: Verifies hydrogeologic confinement and aquifer contamination clearance（AQFR）
information_points.content:
HYDRO-AQFR-3HS：For the Caldron Caldera Subsurface Facility, regional environmental protection audit results confirm that environmental aquifer protection clearance is granted for overlying freshwater aquifers within a 5 km radius of the well pad, verifying double-casing hydraulic isolation integrity.
HYDRO-AQFR-2AV：For the Granite Ridge Deep Shaft Complex, environmental aquifer protection clearance is approved based on the regional environmental protection audit covering overlying freshwater aquifers within a 5 km radius of the well pad.
HYDRO-AQFR-FPY：For the Pinon Basalt Horizon Laboratory, regional environmental protection audit findings indicate that environmental aquifer protection clearance has not been obtained for overlying freshwater aquifers within a 5 km radius of the well pad.
